timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹519.4 Cr (-6.0% YoY), net profit ₹14.4 Cr (-71.3% YoY).
Hikal reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹519 Cr with an EBITDA margin of 20.3% and net profit of ₹14 Cr.
RAJASEKHAR REDDY, Chairman, signed the audio recording of the Q4FY26 earnings call on May 27, 2026, available at the provided link.
B.N. Kalyani, Promoter of Hikal Limited, declared no promoter group shares were encumbered during FY2025-26, covering 31.36% (KICL) and 2.65% (BFIL).
Hikal held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 27, 2026, discussing operational momentum and recovery prospects.
Hikal Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 06, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹403 Cr and guiding FY27 revenue growth at 14-16% with EBITDA growth at 25-30%.
Hikal Limited's Bengaluru API facility earned Swissmedic GMP certification, expanding access to European markets.
